title: An absolutely pinned chariot's threat is not a chase
rationale: The white chariot shuttles between d4 and d3 and appears to attack the black cannon on b4 and b3 along the rank, but it is absolutely pinned on the d-file by the black chariot on d7 against the white king on d1: its legal moves at every ply of this history are d-file moves only, so the capture is never available. An attack the chasing piece could not legally make is not a threat and is not a chase, so the repetition is neutral and merely claimable at the third occurrence. Guarded fork correction P1, which landed at afec5690: before it the engine ruled this position wrongly, and this fixture is what says so.
